N.promptText: [S1] At two forty-seven in the morning, a number he didn't know sent him a text. Jay was playing The Endless Halls. The game where the tall man only moves when you look away.

lines.text: A hundred players. The floor is lava. And only one of these best friends can win.
lines.cap: A hundred players. The floor is *lava.* And only *one* of these best friends can win.
lines.dia: A hundred players. The floor is lava. And only one of these best friends can win. Just one.

lines.text: Every Friday night, Jay and Maya played Floor Is Lava.
lines.cap: Every Friday night, Jay and Maya played *Floor Is Lava.*
lines.dia: Every Friday night, Jay and Maya played Floor Is Lava. Every week.

lines.text: The floor drops away one tile at a time. Fall in, and you're out.
lines.cap: The floor drops away *one tile at a time.* Fall in, and you're *out.*
lines.dia: The floor drops away one tile at a time. Fall in, and you're out. Simple.

lines.text: They made a deal. Stick together, no matter what.
lines.cap: They made a deal. *Stick together,* no matter what.
lines.dia: They made a deal. Stick together, no matter what. Always.

lines.text: Who would you team up with? Comment it.
lines.cap: Who would *you* team up with? Comment it.
lines.dia: Who would you team up with? Comment it. Go on.
Ninety players gone. Then ninety-eight. Just two left.

lines.text: One platform left. Room for one.
lines.dia: One platform left. Room for one. Only one.

lines.text: Maya had never won a single round. Not once.
lines.cap: Maya had never won a single round. *Not once.*
lines.dia: Maya had never won a single round. Not once. Ever.

lines.text: Would you jump, or let her win? Comment it.
lines.cap: Would you *jump,* or *let her win?* Comment it.
lines.dia: Would you jump, or let her win? Comment it. Be honest.

lines.text: Jay stepped back... and let the floor take him.
lines.cap: Jay stepped back... and let the floor *take him.*
lines.dia: Jay stepped back... and let the floor take him. Gone.

lines.text: Then something popped up that nobody had ever seen.
lines.cap: Then something popped up that *nobody had ever seen.*
lines.dia: Then something popped up that nobody had ever seen. Ever.

lines.text: Would you do what Jay did? Comment it.
lines.cap: Would you do what *Jay* did? Comment it.
lines.dia: Would you do what Jay did? Comment it. Be honest.

lines.text: Floor Is Lava is one of tons of free games on Pulsebox. Racing, heists, horror, sports.
lines.cap: *Floor Is Lava* is one of *tons* of free games on Pulsebox. Racing, heists, horror, sports.
lines.dia: Floor Is Lava is one of tons of free games on Pulsebox. Racing, heists, horror, sports. And more.

lines.text: Free at box dot pulseform dot org. Play it on a computer.
lines.cap: Free at... *box.pulseform.org.* Play it on a *computer.*
lines.dia: Free at box dot pulseform dot org. Play it on a computer. Today.
